title: A/R Detail: exporting with every bucket closed still downloads every row
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has three open invoices on today's date, in two different aging buckets.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S3-28 Closed Buckets.
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with the Customer filter showing only {Customer-A} ticked.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the chevron button in the table's top-left header cell until its tooltip reads "Expand all" (every bucket closed).
  2. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  3. Open the CSV and read its rows.
  4. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  5. Open the PDF and read its rows.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: every bucket is closed: no document row shows on screen.
  • Step 2: the CSV downloads with the "Success" message "Data exported successfully."; no "Empty export" warning shows.
  • Step 3: one row for each of {Customer-A}'s three invoices, then the Totals row: the same rows the report has with its buckets open.
  • Step 4: the PDF downloads with the "Success" message.
  • Step 5: the same three invoices and the Totals row.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • S3-R3: “The PDF and the CSV contain exactly the rows on screen for the chosen as-of date, customer or vendor and locations, in the on-screen sort, including a sort changed after an earlier export, without refreshing the page.”
  • S3-R10: “A successful export shows the native "Success" message, "Data exported successfully." An export with no rows downloads nothing and shows the native warning "Empty export", "Export didn't yield any results".”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §3 D28, rationale: “On Detail reports with every bucket collapsed no rows are loaded, so a loaded-rows check would wrongly say "Empty export" (S3-R10).”
  • Tech plan §3 D28: “Empty-export detection reads the report's server count, never loaded rows: Summaries pagination.rowsNumber; Collection/Unpaid totals.documentCount; Detail totals.rowsNumber from the groups query”
